items.text:
Hi, I'm planning a week in Porto for my parents' anniversary in late September and I'd like the booking assistant to line up a few options before I commit. Can you put together two or three hotels near the Ribeira with breakfast included, and a rough idea of flight prices from Manchester for the Tuesday to Tuesday?

Nothing fancy needed on the rooms, just somewhere quiet and walkable. If the automated tool flags anything as sold out, don't worry about it, I'd rather see the alternatives than have it silently swap things around. Once I've got the shortlist I'll run it past my sister and come back to you.

intent.requested_action: shortlist Porto hotels and flight prices

items.text:
Hello, I'm sorting out the holiday rota for the Madrid office and I want to combine it with a short break, so I'd like you to look at flights out on the Friday evening and back on the Sunday. The whole team uses the travel assistant here, and it's been handy for comparing fares, so whatever it suggests I'll check against my own notes.

One thing I'd appreciate: keep the budget under £300 return if you can, and show me the times rather than just the cheapest option. If the automated tool can't find anything direct, a stopover is fine as long as it doesn't eat the whole weekend.

That's it for now; I'll confirm once the rota is signed off by the administrator.

intent.requested_action: find weekend flights to Madrid under budget

items.text:
Hi there, I'm handling the school trip to York in June for thirty Year 8 pupils, and I'd like your travel assistant to pull together coach quotes and a couple of hostel options near the centre. We've used the automated tool before for the ski trip and it worked well, so I'm happy to trust its shortlist as a starting point.

Key things: the coach needs to leave before 8am and be back by 6pm, and the hostel must have a secure room for luggage. Please show me cancellation terms too; the head teacher won't sign anything without them.

If anything looks like it's running over budget, flag it rather than trimming the itinerary. I'll bring the numbers to the next planning meeting.

intent.requested_action: gather coach quotes and hostel options for a school trip
